profile_text: As a specialty coffee beans supplier, this Düsseldorf-based coffee roastery has experienced rapid growth of 308.9% since its baseline, driven by increasing demand for high-quality coffee. With 184 employees as of 2024, the company is well-positioned to meet the needs of its customers, leveraging its expertise in coffee roasting to deliver unique and distinctive flavors. This growth trajectory has earned the company a "Scaler" designation, reflecting its significant expansion in the food service activities sector.
